full_judgment: 2. Necessary facts for the purpose of the Rule are that one Abed All filed a petition of complaint being No.278 of 2012 in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Cognizance Court No.2, Dhaka against the accused persons including the petitioner alleging, inter alia, that the case property measuring .20 decimals in RS Plot No.535 of RS Khatian No.370 belonged to Abed Ali; that the accused petitioner Nos.1 to 5 collusively created a false power of attorney being No.15171 dated 25.10.2011 in south Keranigonj Sub-registry office in the name of accused petitioner No.1; that on the basis of this forged ammoktemama the accused No.1, Md. Liton executed a kabala deed on 28.02.2012 measuring .20 decimals which was registered on 29.02.2012 in the Keranigonj Sub-registry office being Kabala No.2191 in favour of the East West Properties Development Limited and the petitioner No.1 is the Managing Director of this company and that the Kabala dated 29.02.2012 is forged one which was created collusively. Hence the case
